subject.title: fix(signal): preserve durable ingress retry ownership

question: Should Signal retain the full debounced-flush retry owner while suppressing nested dispatch retries for reply-session initialization conflicts?
rationale: This changes the ownership and cancellation boundary for durable ingress claims; tests alone do not establish that the outer owner covers all live retry, shutdown, and claim-abandonment paths.

options.title: Confirm owner boundary after live proof
options.body: Require a redacted Signal monitor run that triggers the conflict, aborts the monitor, and visibly shows no retained pending or claimed ingress work before approving the bounded retry override.

options.title: Keep nested retries
options.body: Reject the override if the full-flush owner cannot be shown to cover every dispatch retry and shutdown path.

recommendation.title: Confirm owner boundary after live proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted Signal monitor run that triggers the conflict, aborts the monitor, and visibly shows no retained pending or claimed ingress work before approving the bounded retry override.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR commits and rationale define the proposed Signal retry-owner boundary; an area owner should validate that intended contract.
